verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a business-registry portal. The only evidence is glancing and read-only: a passing mention that 'requestors of Bulk data' receive files reflecting entity numbers, and a downloadable list of active notaries. Filings themselves are one-at-a-time through the bizfile web portal, mail or in person. No API or OpenAPI spec was found, and the portal sits behind bot management that blocks keyless agents. Missing for 10: documented bulk data product details (access, format, scope), bulk or batch filing or update operations, a programmatic or API path for multi-item actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
